review:
Blazing Fire Pots Hold & Spin is a fast classic slot with a Hold and Spin bonus and five fixed jackpots: Mini (25x), Minor (50x), Major (100x), Mega (1,000x) and Grand (5,000x).

Three Blazing Firepot symbols trigger the bonus. A Respin Ante adds 40% to your bet to trigger it 50% faster: if two firepots land, a respin tries to complete the trigger, and during that respin only firepot symbols are active. The game is tuned for quick rounds and frequent features. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 96.27% RTP. Ideal for players who enjoy jackpot-style land-based games.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
